Suggested rewrite: use "cinematic realistic style" instead of "real person / hyper-realistic", and "clashing / sparring / parrying" instead of "kill / slay". Submit anyway?

assistant.title: Direct by Chat
assistant.noSelection: Click any node on the canvas to see its settings here.
assistant.multiSelection: {count} nodes selected; details show for one node at a time.
